   codecs/stores: the §7.3 **CI and refresh** rows — (a) a static
   both-modes check proving committed example equivalence/pins

   docs/research reads) under ADR-0362's exact classifier, (c)

2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping

3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.29 `example-card/1` +

   check-quickstart committed-HEAD precedent. A new shared/persisted
   decision lands in the owning ADR admission (landing-record ADR).

## Plan

1. `scripts/check-examples.sh` (new, ~180 lines) — static checker,
   no build/network:
   - default mode validates the working tree: every
     `scripts/examples/*.json` card decodes as `example-card/1`
     (closed member set + admitted `case` set extracted from
     `crates/hharness/src/examples.rs` — canonical source, never a
     second table); every `pins.<name>.{path,sha256}` recomputes over
     the pinned file's bytes (missing/stale fails; path traversal
     refused); every card `checks[]` id resolves to a check-id
     literal the runner emits (`pass`/`fail`/`fail_json`/
     `expected_refusal` first args); displayed-vs-canonical: the
     `<!-- examples:begin -->…<!-- examples:end -->` fenced `sh`
     block in `docs/getting-started.md` must list each card's `run`
     member exactly once, and `scripts/examples/README.md` must name
     each card + its `run`; honest line `live: skipped(…)` — never
     a pass.
   - `--head` mode: clean clone of HEAD (check-quickstart.sh
     precedent) → same validation inside the clone; uncommitted
     working-tree edits are never the tested HEAD.
2. `scripts/run-examples.sh` (new, ~45 lines) — the §7.3 "full
   offline" lane: scratch dirs, `cargo test -p hharness --test
   r5_29` over the committed cards (canonical inputs only — zero
   docs/research reads), diagnostics bound + honest `live:
   skipped(…)` tail line.
3. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — (a) `test-check-examples.sh` added
   to the both-mode self-test step (before `id: path`); (b) a
   `# ci-mode: both — …` step running `check-examples.sh` +
   `--head` (it reads committed content under docs/); (c) a gated
   `mode != 'fast' && ubuntu` step running `run-examples.sh` beside
   the Quickstart leg. Anchor pair stays last, byte-identical.
4. `docs/getting-started.md` — "Learn offline" section with the
   `<!-- examples:… -->` displayed command block (the docs/
   displayed surface the both-mode lane checks).
5. `MAINTAINING.md` — "Example checks and refresh" section: the
   three check classes, the lane table, the code/freshness/study
   refresh triggers with supersession, 30-day refresh-due rule,
   preserve-historical-negatives.
6. `scripts/examples/README.md` — index the two checks.
7. `scripts/ci/test-check-examples.sh` (new, ~160 lines) — fixture
   self-test: clean tree passes; broken card (extra/missing member,
   unadmitted case), stale pin, stale/missing displayed block,
   runner-unmapped check id all fail; `--head` ignores working-tree
   dirt but fails on committed drift; the real ci.yml minus the
   `ci-mode: both` annotation fails check-ci-gating.
8. Build-memory records: this ledger, landing ADR-0408 + index/
   revisit regeneration + BL-47 sources cell, dated coverage note
   (REQ-F-106/107/108 — achieved engineered D/E; no second primary
   owner), `docs/build/pr/R5.30.md`, closeout (BUILD_INDEX seq-200,
   LEDGER advance, ci-boundary).
